stalls.summaryZh: 旱溪夜市代表攤之一，豆干滷得入味再淋蒜汁，網友常說必排。
stalls.summaryEn: A signature Hanxi stall: well-braised tofu doused in garlic sauce, often named a must-queue.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 方臉師傅蒜香豆干店家資訊
食尚玩家 台中夜市懶人包（2025-11）

stalls.summaryZh: 古早味鳳梨冰飲，酸甜消暑，逛夜市時很多人人手一杯。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-style pineapple ice drink, sweet-tart and refreshing; many visitors carry one around.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 台中夜市懶人包（2025-11）
好好玩FUNIT 台中夜市整理

stalls.summaryZh: 旋轉炭烤再刷醬撒粉，辣度可調；常要先登記號碼再回來取。
stalls.summaryEn: Corn rotated over charcoal, brushed with sauce and spice; adjustable heat, and you often register first and pick up later.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤 旱溪夜市六攤（2025-11）

stalls.summaryZh: 手工豬肉高麗菜水餃配自調辣醬油，被推薦當正餐墊胃。
stalls.summaryEn: Handmade pork-and-cabbage dumplings with house chili soy sauce, recommended as a filling base.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤 旱溪夜市六攤（2025-11）

stalls.summaryZh: 地瓜球、拔絲地瓜與薯條一盒搞定，糖衣脆口；出攤日較不固定。
stalls.summaryEn: A box mixing sweet potato balls, candied sweet potato and fries with a crackly glaze; days are a bit irregular.
